items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk loses trillionaire status as SpaceX and Tesla stock drops
items.summary_cn: Musk 因 SpaceX 与 Tesla 股价下跌失去万亿富豪身家，反映 SpaceX IPO 后估值波动与 Tesla 承压。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk denies Tesla’s Autopilot caused crash that killed grandmother
items.summary_cn: Musk 否认 Tesla Autopilot 导致致亡事故，监管/诉讼风险仍是 Tesla 估值变量。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk's SpaceX Could Acquire T-Mobile In Wireless Push, Says Analyst
items.summary_cn: 分析师称 SpaceX 可能收购 T-Mobile 加码无线业务，间接利好 SpaceX 相关持仓（SPCH）。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Stock Selloff Costs Elon Musk His $1 Trillion Net Worth
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 股价抛售致 Musk 财富缩水，SPCH（2x 做多 SpaceX ETF）直接受拖累，是 kcn 持仓相关的高信号新闻。

items.author: Musk
items.text: After $86 billion IPO, SpaceX to borrow $20 billion
items.summary_cn: SpaceX IPO 估值 860 亿美元后拟再举债 200 亿美元，杠杆扩张对二级市场股价是双刃剑，SPCH 波动放大。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX's drop off sees Elon Musk's net worth fall $240 billion—roughly the same value as computing giant IBM
items.summary_cn: SpaceX 估值大幅缩水约 2400 亿美元（约等于 IBM），直接利空 kcn 持有的 SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s SpaceX has been on a wild ride post-IPO. Should you try to get on?
items.summary_cn: 讨论 SpaceX 上市后剧烈波动及是否值得买入，与 kcn 通过 SPCH 间接持有 SpaceX 直接相关。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Why Elon Musk is no longer a trillionaire
items.summary_cn: Musk 因 SpaceX 估值回落失去万亿身价，对 SPCH 持仓偏空信号。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The big Oil Companies are not dropping their price at the pump commensurate with the sharply lower prices they are paying for Oil. Those prices are dropping like a rock! In other words, customers are being “gouged.” I have instructed the DOJ to immediately start looking into this. Gasoline prices better start going down a lot faster than what I’m seeing! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump 指控大型油企对消费者'价格欺诈'并指示 DOJ 调查，要求油价更快下跌，能源股短期承压。

items.author: Trump
items.text: Iran has informed the U.S. that, despite troublemaking Fake News reporting to the contrary, there are “NO TOLLS, NO INSURANCE COSTS, & NO OTHER CHARGES OF ANY KIND BEING SOUGHT OR RECEIVED BY IRAN ON SHIPS TRAVELING THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ. If this is false information, negotiations would end, immediately! Additionally, no money has been given to Iran, or released from their money to them, by the U.S. We will be releasing some of their money, that is totally controlled by us, to our Farmers and Ranchers, for the purchase of Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, and more. Food is desperately needed in Iran, and
items.summary_cn: Trump 称伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡未收费，谈判若破局将立即终止；并提及释放伊朗资金购买美国玉米/小麦/大豆，对原油运输和农产品出口有影响。

items.author: Trump
items.text: RT @realDonaldTrumpWow! The Senate just changed its vote on Iran from 50-48 against, to 50-47 for. Rand Paul and Bill Cassidy changed. Thank you to Leader John Thune, Lindsey Graham, Bernie Moreno, and all. This vote puts Iran on notice! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump 庆祝参议院通过对伊朗更强硬议案，暗示对伊施压升级，原油与中东地缘风险溢价上升。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The Elizabeth “Pocahontas” Warren centric housing bill, which is of minor importance compared to lower interest rates, and even FISA, pales in comparison to passing THE SAVE AMERICA ACT. That is what Americans, both Dumocrats, Republicans, and everyone else, care about. Get the bad Republicans to approve it or, better yet, Terminate the Filibuster and approve it, AND EVERYTHING ELSE REPUBLICANS HAVE EVER DREAMED OF. The Dumocrats will do it in hour one, 100%. Republicans will feel very stupid if they don’t do it first. I’ll be watching with tears in my eyes!!! President DJT
items.summary_cn: Trump 抨击 Warren 住房法案、强调降息与立法优先级，间接利好利率敏感板块（房地产/科技）。

items.author: Trump
items.text: So, I have Iran on the “ropes,” ready to go down for the fall, willing to give us practically anything, and for the first time in decades, respecting the hell out of the United States and its President, ME, and the U.S. Senate decides to have a poorly timed and meaningless War Powers Act Vote, telling the Number One Sponser of Terror in the World that the United States doesn’t  like what I am doing to them, and I must stop, and by so doing has provided aid and comfort the Enemy. Four Republican Losers voted with the Dumocrats, and Iran asked my people, “what does that all mean?” These Senators
items.summary_cn: Trump 抨击部分共和党参议员在 War Powers Act 表决上'资敌'，延续对伊朗强硬叙事，影响军工与原油预期。
